critical_code_review_comments: Journey JRN-81 copy references '1:54pm' but engine's demo-clock interpolation and seed produce '1:45pm' on the Driver phone (and '1:50pm' in the customer phone reason line). Journey explicitly allows 'or very close' — fine, but worth aligning JRN-81 wording with engine output to avoid future testing confusion.

pytest.ini still defaults to '-n 2 --dist loadscope' while suites mutate shared demo + AI config state and MUST be run with '-n 0' (same note as iteration 6). Repeat: switch default to -n 0 or add a per-session Mongo lock, otherwise next tester may see flakes.

Phone message payloads use field 'text' consistently (customer/driver/owner). Any helper or test that spells it 'body' will silently return empty — document the schema near phones_api.py or add a Pydantic model.
